canonical_project: LVL Energy data center with BESS, Tucznawa investment zone, Dabrowa Gornicza
notes: Municipal announcement says LVL Energy bought a 3.9282 ha plot in Tucznawa for a modern data processing center plus about 200 MW battery storage; implementation is planned for 2026-2030, with operations planned in early 2031. DCD reports the data center component as 50 MW.
